independence.basis: Independent operator task. Before freeze it inspected only public code, methodology, preregistration, attestations, reuse determination, file identities, and aggregate metadata; the sealed dataset was handled only as an opaque path and digest.

execution.two_build_capture_reproducibility: PASS: 64/64 complete MCP responses, response digests, token counts, prompts, and all 5 designated follow-up reads were byte-identical across distinct ready index generations; maximum candidate response 1194/1200 cl100k; follow-up reads obey the separately frozen 120-line contract
execution.per_item_command: codex exec --ephemeral --ignore-user-config --ignore-rules -s read-only -m <model> -c model_reasoning_effort="high" -C <new empty git repository> --json -o <output> - < <single allowed input>
execution.failure_policy: Any process error, unexpected event or item type, nonempty required output failure, overwrite attempt, binding drift, validation error, or capture mismatch refuses the run without retry.

limitations: OpenAI exposes no immutable backend model snapshot/build digest, so participant model behavior is not byte-reproducible.
The unchanged dataset carries its original compact/16 curation note; the authoritative compact/17 binding is the distinct curation preregistration and forthcoming harness records in this run.
